results.note: psp.cz records the first reading of the 2027 budget (tisk 324) on 22 Oct 2026, with the approval vote 34/237 passed at 22:28 (92 for, 60 against); this is before the 23 Oct 23:59 deadline, so the criterion is met as written even though the vote came a day earlier than expected.
The first-reading approval vote 34/237 on 22 Oct 2026 had 92 'ano' votes, short of the 105 required.

We could not search ČTK/ceskenoviny directly; Echo24 reports only that Babiš will negotiate mortgage prices with the banks, and ČT24's bank-tax topic page has no 2026 item, so no statement that the government will introduce a bank tax or levy was found by the deadline.

g1 could not be fetched; Gazeta do Povo (published 23/10/2026 22:33) reports both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro took part in the TV Globo runoff debate on Friday 23 October; only one independent outlet was checked.
maariv.co.il could not be fetched; the Jerusalem Post (23 Oct 2026, 13:27) reports Maariv's Lazar Research poll published Friday 23 October giving Eisenkot's Yashar 21 seats and Likud 19.

cbr.ru could not be fetched; TASS quotes the press release ('On 23 October 2026, the Bank of Russia Board of Directors decided to keep the key rate at 14.00% per annum'), and the Moscow Times and Reuters (via Investing.com) also report a hold at 14%.
The ONS bulletin published 23 October 2026 says retail sales volumes are estimated to have fallen by 0.4% in September 2026.
The S&P Global flash eurozone PMI release of 23 October 2026 gives a composite output index of 51.9 (down from 53.1), below 53.0.

assemblee-nationale.fr was unreachable (fetch refused); LCP's Budget 2027 dossier carries no 49.3 on the PLF or PLFSS 2027, and a news search found no report of the government engaging its responsibility by 23 Oct.

Légifrance was unreachable (fetch refused); Actu-Juridique (20 Oct) states no decree under the 1955 law has been published and Le Club des juristes (21 Oct) says the government preferred local curfews, and a search found no decree published by 23 Oct.

cne.gob.ve was unreachable (fetch refused); NTN24 reports Delcy Rodríguez refusing to set a date ("Yo no fijo fechas") with Reuters pointing to late 2027, and a search found no CNE or Rodríguez announcement of a date by 23 Oct.

state.gov was unreachable (fetch refused); the Pakistani report of a further round with "time and venue to be decided later" dates from 13 April 2026 and names no date anyway, and a search found no official US or Iranian statement naming a date by 23 Oct.

kremlin.ru was unreachable (fetch refused); the latest on-record remark found is Zelensky's of 4 Oct that Ukraine is ready 'by the end of October', which names no calendar date, and a search found no Kremlin, White House or Ukrainian presidency announcement of a date by 23 Oct.

hrad.cz could not be read (Cloudflare challenge); a search of hrad.cz, ČT24, iROZHLAS and ČTK found no published list of 2026 honours recipients and no media report of one by 23 Oct, consistent with the Castle practice under Pavel of naming recipients only at the ceremony.

The prefecture site could not be checked; Yahoo Actualités (relaying a national outlet) and CNews report a Préfecture de police arrêté issued on Friday 23 October declaring the Bastille–Nation march route for 24 October 'interdit' (an alternative Porte d'Italie–Porte de Vincennes route was offered); read as a ban on demonstrating in part of Paris, which required interpretation.
